name: Reacharound
summary: Bedrock-style block placement: when looking at empty space just beyond the block you are bridging from, you can place a block there without sneaking to the edge. Also works for building downward and upward, with an on-screen indicator.

mechanics.title: Reach-around placement
mechanics.description: Place blocks against the face you cannot directly see (under your feet, bridging forward, or upward) with a placement indicator showing the target.

mechanics.title: Slab handling
mechanics.description: Bridging upper slabs with slabs keeps them as upper slabs, and slabs placed vertically stack without skipping.

mechanics.title: Indicator
mechanics.description: Three indicator styles (Default, Quark, Custom), with 2D/3D rendering, colours, offhand placement and axis options in the config screen (via Mod Menu).

commands_and_keybinds: A key mapping is registered; check the Controls screen for the Reacharound entry. Default key not confirmed.
getting_started: Aim at the empty space past the edge of a block while bridging; the indicator shows where the block will go; right-click to place.
editor_notes: Core functionality ported from Quark. Default keybind/toggle not verified.
